newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen mixed at open, techs seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen mixed at open, techs seen higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to have a mixed opening on Tuesday, with the recently-strong technology sector providing an upward bias.
Bargain hunters could step in, after U.S. blue chips stocks finished lower on Monday, analysts said.
Much of the focus would be in the technology stocks, with both Motorola Inc and Advanced Micro Devices Inc reporting results after the market close, they said.
The 30-share Dow Jones Industrial Average closed down 37.32 points at 7,858.49 on Monday as investors paused after a blistering three-session run that put the blue-chip index in record territory.
